commands: set -e; PREFIX="$PWD/.deps/prefix"; mkdir -p .deps; if [ ! -f "$PREFIX/lib/libevent.a" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch release-2.1.12-stable https://github.com/libevent/libevent.git .deps/libevent; cmake -S .deps/libevent -B .deps/libevent/build -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -DEVENT__DISABLE_OPENSSL=ON -DEVENT__DISABLE_BENCHMARK=ON -DEVENT__DISABLE_TESTS=ON -DEVENT__DISABLE_SAMPLES=ON -DEVENT__LIBRARY_TYPE=STATIC; cmake --build .deps/libevent/build -j"$(nproc)"; cmake --install .deps/libevent/build; fi; ./autogen.sh; ./configure --enable-static --disable-shared CPPFLAGS="-I$PREFIX/include" LDFLAGS="-L$PREFIX/lib" LIBS="-levent -lpthread"; make -j"$(nproc)"
